content_sections.heading: AVS Assam Accountant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AVS Assam Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download AVS Assam Accountant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: AVS Assam Accountant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available – 1 for the Accountant post.

content_sections.heading: AVS Assam Accountant Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: M.Com from a recognized University with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade. Computer Certificate/Diploma of minimum 6 (Six) months duration with good knowledge of Tally software. Minimum 1 years of relevant post qualification working experience in budgeting, accounting, financial management for large scale programmes/projects etc. in reputed institutions/organizations. Preference shall be given to applicants having experience of working in Government programmes or externally aided projects and knowledge of Government accounting, income Tax, GST & other taxations.

content_sections.text: Document Verification Aptitude Test Writing Skill & Computer Literacy Test Interview

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Accountant post is scheduled for 11 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Accountant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Com degree with a minimum of 55% marks, along with a Computer Certificate/Diploma of at least 6 months duration with Tally software knowledge.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this Accountant role?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 1 year of relevant post-qualification experience in budgeting, accounting, and financial management is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Accountant post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Accountant position is between 26 years and 40 years, as of 01 January 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Accountant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month, with a potential for a 3% annual increment if the contract is extended.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the AVS Assam Accountant recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Accountant role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification, an Aptitude Test, a Writing Skill & Computer Literacy Test, and a final Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the AVS Assam office in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781019.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity with Adarsha Vidyalaya Sangathan Assam.
